value.rationale: K3,n is a natural infinite nonplanar graph family with no pair of vertex-disjoint cycles. A uniform integral symmetry description, its rational Specht identification, the sharp 24-square systole, exact 3 binom(n,4) primitive minimizer count and integral span supply geometric structure invisible to known ordered Betti numbers. The support statement is normalized to the canonical cubical model and motivated by unavailable product-torus generators.
